context_sources.description: Later published account of the 6 June 2019 event and the design question concerning sensor packages for roughly 200 solar-system objects.
Report describes revenue minister Chandrakant Patil as also handling the agriculture portfolio. The article is linked, not copied.

context_sources.author: Luke Nathan Hayes
context_sources.description: Luke links early observation/technology work with Future Space Weather News, the solar-system satellite swarm and attraction to Space Development Nexus in India, leading to his Kolhapur 2019 stage appearance with Maharashtra's agriculture/revenue minister for a Space Tinkering Lab opening and student rocket competition.
context_sources.historical_label_note: The contemporary saved post calls the event the SDNx Innovation Lab inauguration. The causal connection, Space Tinkering Lab and student rocket competition wording are Luke's 17 October 2026 account.

rights: Original photographs, social post and newspaper clipping retain their source rights and attributions.
